name: DAFFY09_ST_PLACARD

name: DAFFY09_ST_CINE_INTRO
meaning: SetState 1: StartCine(cine) + anim TALK1; Update: -> 7 when finished (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_CINE_DISGUISE
meaning: SetState 2: StartCine(cineDeguis) + anim TALK1; Update: -> 7 or walk out (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_WALK_OUT
meaning: SetState 3: walkOut trajectory, Wolf frozen, anim WALK1; Update: -> 4 at the end (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_TURN0
meaning: SetState 4: anim TURN0; Update: on anim end -> 5 (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_TURN1
meaning: SetState 5: msg 0x3d to the SwirlSign, anim TURN1; Update: on anim end -> 6 (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_WALK_BACK
meaning: SetState 6: walkBack trajectory, anim WALK1; Update: -> 7 at the end (inferred)

name: DAFFY09_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 7: releases the Wolf and camera, anim STAND1; Update: waits for the activation box / disguise boxes (inferred)
